instruction.text: Read the story and answer the questions.

atoms.text:
Beatrice the bear likes living in her cave. It keeps her warm and safe. It also has a big front garden — the entire forest!

In winter, her cave will keep her warm while she sleeps away the cold weather.
atoms.sound: ssml: Beatrice the bear likes living in her cave. It keeps her warm and safe. It also has a big front garden — the entire forest! In winter, her cave will keep her warm while she sleeps away the cold weather.

atoms.text:
Before winter, Beatrice has to eat enough to stay full until spring!

“Fishing is my favourite thing to do!” says Beatrice. She eats salmon a lot, but she also eats nuts, berries, grasses, insects, other animals and even human food. She eats almost anything!

Beatrice swims in the river and grows big and strong in the warm months.

She eats salmon a lot, but she also eats nuts, berries, grasses, insects, other animals and even human food. She eats almost anything! Beatrice swims in the river and grows big and strong in the warm months.

atoms.text:
Beatrice may eat almost anything, but her absolute favourite thing to eat is honey. “I love honey!” she roars.

But honey can be risky. She has to watch out for the bees! The bees make honey from flowers and don’t want to give up their hard work so easily.
atoms.sound: ssml: Beatrice may eat almost anything, but her absolute favourite thing to eat is honey. <voice voice='f14'>“I love honey!” </voice> <break time='200ms'/> she roars. But honey can be risky. She has to watch out for the bees! The bees make  honey from flowers and don’t want to give up their hard work so easily.

atoms.text:
At the end of the day, she returns to her cave.

She sleeps with her head out of the front to watch the stars and dreams of another day of swimming and eating honey.
